data.raw_text:
This evening at the One World One Family World Cultural Festival, the stage lit up with “Sita: The Ramayana Revisited,” a stirring theatrical presentation from the Philippines by the Integrated Performing Arts Guild (IPAG) under the visionary guidance of Dr Steven Fernandez. 🇵🇭✨

Told through the eyes of Sita, this contemporary retelling of the Ramayana offered a powerful reflection on courage, compassion, and conviction. Standing between love and duty, peace and war, Sita’s choice to uphold truth in the face of fire became a timeless reminder of strength anchored in righteousness.

Her unwavering courage and steadfastness inspire us to uphold truth and dharma in our own lives. As Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai reminded us, “When we open our hearts to dialogue, we become closer. The world needs living examples of righteousness, people who stand by their convictions and live by dharma.”

#SriMadhusudanSai #WCF100 #OneWorldOneFamilyMission #Philippines #IPAG
